name: Feathered Fate
desc4:
When the equipper enters the battlefield or is switched to as the active character, they gain a buff: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 50, and if the equipper is a <color=#FFA9DD>Lumen Attribute</color> character, Attribute Anomaly Damage Dealt increases by 15%, lasting 15s;
When the equipper is not the active character, they always retain this buff.
